archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted for Heavy Industrial B2B)
global_vibe: Solid, precise, authoritative, and heavy-duty. Evokes raw metal, blueprint precision, and high-stakes reliability. No soft edges, no playful 'tech startup' aesthetics.

rules: No Inter, No Space Grotesk, No generic SaaS fonts.
Import fallback fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow:wght@500;700;900&family=Chivo:wght@300;400;600&display=swap');
Headlines MUST be uppercase or highly structured, utilizing tracking-tight.
Use bold/black weights (700-900) for hero texts and key metrics to convey 'heavy weight'.

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase

borders_and_surfaces.radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm. Max 4px radius to keep the industrial sharpness.
borders_and_surfaces.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px solid borders (border-border/40). For critical UI (like quote forms), use a thicker left or bottom border (border-l-4 border-primary) to anchor it.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-none hover:bg-secondary transition-colors duration-300 border-b-4 border-orange-700 active:border-b-0 active:translate-y-1
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-none

ui_elements.hexagonal_motif: Use clip-path polygons for certain profile images or small icon wrappers to reference the screw head. Example CSS class: `clip-hexagon { clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 25%, 100% 75%, 50% 100%, 0% 75%, 0% 25%); }`

layout.spacing: Generous vertical spacing (py-20 to py-32) between sections. Tight, technical spacing (gap-4) inside data/capability grids.
layout.grid_strategy: Use 'Control Room' grid for services and features to maximize scannability. Grid items must be strictly aligned with no jagged bottoms (h-full).

sections.name: Header
sections.design: Dark, glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#12181E]/80), border-b border-white/10. Logo on left, links center, Quote CTA on right. Must be visible always.

sections.name: Hero
sections.design: Background image with heavy dark overlay (bg-[#12181E]/80). Left-aligned massive typography. 25+ years badge. Primary CTA: 'Solicita Cotización'. Subtle grid/blueprint CSS pattern over the background.

sections.name: About & Values
sections.design: Split layout: Narrative on left, Industrial visual on right. Below it, a 5-column grid or Bento layout for the 5 values (Honestidad, Responsabilidad, Disciplina, Puntualidad, Dignidad). Use hexagonal icon wrappers for values.

sections.name: Services Grid
sections.design: Cards with solid Petroleum Blue backgrounds, thin borders. 1 large hero service (col-span-2 or row-span-2) and 4 standard ones. Include heavy machinery/metal icons.

sections.name: Industries
sections.design: Use the real backup images as backgrounds for tall cards (aspect-[3/4]). Hover state reveals industry details. Industries: Minería, Cemento, Aeroespacial, Automotriz, Petrolero/Gas.

sections.name: Quote Form Banner & Form
sections.design: Darkest background section. 2-column layout. Left: Persuasive text, trust cues (contact info, emergency 24/7). Right: Complex form using Shadcn. Form inputs must have square corners, dark backgrounds (bg-slate-900/50), border-white/20, focus:border-primary.

sections.name: Footer
sections.design: Massive py-20. 4 columns (Brand, Services, Contact, Legal). Dark background, subdued text, clear hierarchy. Include logo in negative.

motion.rules: No bouncy/spring animations. Use Framer Motion with strict, rigid easing (ease: 'circOut' or 'linear'). Fades and slight vertical slides (y: 20 -> 0) for entrance.

media.images_priority: Use REAL backup images first. Fallback to Unsplash only if necessary.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: You are building a Heavy Industry B2B site. Strip out all Vercel/SaaS defaults from Shadcn components. Override rounded-xl to rounded-none or rounded-sm. No soft shadows. No gradients except dark technical overlays.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: For typography, implement Metropolis via @font-face if possible, otherwise rely on the Google Fonts import (Barlow for headings, Chivo for body). Apply uppercase and tracking-tight to major headers.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: The brand's identity is tied to hexagons (screw heads). Use CSS clip-path: polygon() to create hexagonal containers for icons or small decorative images.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The Quote Form (Cotización) is complex. Must use Shadcn Form elements with strict validation, connected to the FastAPI backend placeholder endpoints.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Data-TestIDs are MANDATORY. Apply `data-testid` attributes (kebab-case, role-based) to all buttons, form inputs, links, and major sections.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Use Lucide-React icons (Hexagon, Factory, HardHat, Wrench, Settings, Clock) heavily in the Services and Values grids.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do NOT use placeholder.com images. Use the precise URLs provided in the media section above.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Inject the provided HSL variables exactly into index.css to configure the dark industrial palette.
